purpose: Synthetic operational knowledge for ParkPulse conversational understanding, retrieval grounding, multi-agent routing, and regression evaluation.

park_objects.name: Entrance Plaza
facts: Distance to Dragon Coaster is 677 meters by the main guest path.

park_objects.name: Dragon Coaster
facts: High-capacity thrill ride in Coaster Plaza.
Queue spillback affects parade crossing and Food Court 1 approach.

park_objects.name: Food Court 1
facts: Busy family dining zone near Entrance Plaza and Coaster Plaza.
Lost-child and medical reports here are guest-care/security incidents, not food operations tickets.

park_objects.name: Care Lagoon
facts: First-aid and family reunification support zone.
Medical, accessibility, and separated-child incidents should preserve service-lane access.

park_objects.name: Covered Plaza
facts: Crowd routing here must consider HVAC load and accessibility lanes.

time_patterns.expected_agent_bias: Food pressure is common, but medical/security reports still outrank kitchen optimization.
Prefer split-flow and staged routing over one large redirect.
Safety and shelter capacity outrank guest preference optimization.
